profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at GovernmentCIO
profile.summary:
Comprehensive experience in software development and architecture of web applications. Able to work in a team environment as well as independently. Strong interpersonal skills. 

Core Competencies: 
✯ n-Tier & MVC Architectures             ✯ Asynchronous Programming       ✯ Database design
✯ System/Application Development    ✯ Application/System Integration    ✯ Unit Testing
✯ RESTful Services                             ✯ Data Migration                             ✯ OO Analysis & Design

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Develops and maintains applications for the Department of Veterans Affairs' National Cemetery Administration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develops and maintains applications for the Department of Veterans Affairs Financial Services Center.

positions.title: Software Developer (full-time telecommute contractor)
positions.description:
Collaborated in the development of new credit card patient payment system for Pacific Dental Services company.

► Added new features to all software applications comprising the new payment system by creating reusable components, web endpoints, and dynamic user interfaces. 
► Created solutions to increase overall performance.
► Worked closely with other developers, QA engineers, product owner and Scrum master. 
► Interacted with DevOps engineers, business analysts and third-party engineers as required.

Platforms/technologies: .NET 4.0/4.5 (MVC, Web API, C#, LINQ), Simple Injector, FakeItEasy, Dapper, AngularJS, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, SQL (SQL Server), Git, JIRA/Bitbucket/Confluence, and Scrum.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented features that enhanced buyer/seller experience on company’s e-Commerce sites.

► Created APIs, components and solutions that reduced development time, and increased scalability as well as overall site performance. 
► Interacted with product managers, marketing, BI analysts, QA engineers, associates, and third party engineers in order to accomplish the task at hand.
► Executed development utilizing Scrum methodology and unit testing. 

Platforms/technologies: .NET 4.5 (MVC, Web API, C#, LINQ, EF), NUnit, Node.js (Express, NodeUnit), JavaScript/JQuery, HTML, CSS, Visual Studio, WebStorm, MySQL, Scrum, JIRA, TFS, Git.

company.name: 11 Main, Inc., an Alibaba Group Company

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Performed software development and architecture of applications/systems to streamline processes and workflows; end users included internal customers throughout the bank as well as external users of the bank’s website. 

► Interacted with executives, managers, and other stakeholders to discuss project requirements and provide recommendations. 
► Worked with systems and network/security engineers to set up web server infrastructure such as web service endpoints and to enforce security policies. 
► Kept abreast of technology trends and led the decision making for technologies, frameworks and tools. 
► Coordinated software development with project manager, developers, and system analyst promoting an Agile-style development process. 
► Guided and trained team members on best practices.

Platforms/technologies: ASP.NET 4.0/2.0 (C#, MVC, Razor, Entity Framework, LINQ, Web API, WebForms), AJAX, ColdFusion, MS SQL Server 2005 (stored procedures, functions, triggers, SSIS), HTML, XML, XSLT, CSS, JQuery/Javascript, REST and JSON.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Co-developed barcode-based search system for mobile users to find time-sensitive offers near a shopping district with the mission of increasing sales of small businesses.

► Assisted in development of administration tool in PHP for merchants to create and manage ads.
► Built e-mailer application in Java to:  1) decode QR code images contained in emails sent by mobile users, 2) reply with sale ads relevant to users' current location.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Software development and maintenance of web-based management tools for online sellers and buyers. Platforms/Languages: .NET 2.0 (C#), MS SQL Server 2000, HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development of web-based applications for the HP’s Information Technology Resource Center (ITRC). Co-developed administration tool front-end for the ITRC Forums using Java technology. Platforms/technologies: Jakarta-Apache’s Struts and Ant, Win CVS, HTML and CSS.
